title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Matthew 20: the laborers in the vineyard, the road to Jerusalem, the request of Zebedee's sons, and two blind men near Jericho.

questions.text: What did the master of the household agree to pay the laborers for the day?
questions.explanation: He agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day and sent them into his vineyard.

answers.text: A measure of grain
A denarius
A share of the harvest
Two talents

questions.text: At what hour did the master go out and ask those standing idle why they stood there all day idle?
questions.explanation: About the eleventh hour he went out, found others standing idle, and asked why they stood there all day idle.

answers.text: About the third hour
About the sixth hour
About the ninth hour
About the eleventh hour

questions.text: In what order did the lord of the vineyard tell his manager to pay the laborers?
questions.explanation: When evening had come he told his manager to call the laborers and pay their wages, beginning from the last to the first.

answers.text: Beginning from the last to the first
Beginning with those hired first
All of them at the same moment
Only those who asked for payment

questions.text: Why did the first laborers murmur against the master of the household?
questions.explanation: They complained that the last had spent only one hour and yet had been made equal to them, who had borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat.

answers.text: Because he paid them in the open marketplace
Because he had hired strangers from another city
Because he made those who worked one hour equal to them
Because he sent them home before evening came

questions.text: How did Jesus end the parable of the laborers?
questions.explanation: He said that the last will be first and the first last, for many are called, but few are chosen.

answers.text: The vineyard will be given to others
The last will be first, and the first last
Each one will receive according to his hours
The idle will have no share at all

questions.text: To whom did Jesus say the Son of Man would be delivered as they went up to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: He told the twelve that the Son of Man would be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, who would condemn him to death.

answers.text: To the chief priests and scribes
To the governor's soldiers
To the Pharisees and Herodians
To the elders of Galilee

questions.text: What did the mother of the sons of Zebedee ask of Jesus?
questions.explanation: She asked that her two sons might sit, one on his right hand and one on his left hand, in his Kingdom.

answers.text: That he would heal her two sons of their sickness
That her sons might be sent out to preach
That her sons might stay with her in Galilee
That her two sons might sit at his right and left hand

questions.text: What did Jesus ask the two brothers in reply?
questions.explanation: He said they did not know what they were asking, and asked whether they were able to drink the cup he was about to drink and be baptized with his baptism.

answers.text: Whether they had left everything behind
Whether they could keep the commandments
Whether they were able to drink the cup he was about to drink
Whether they would stay awake with him

questions.text: What did Jesus say whoever desires to become great must be?
questions.explanation: He said it should not be so among them: whoever desires to become great among them shall be their servant.

answers.text: A servant
A ruler over the nations
A teacher in the synagogue
The first at the table

questions.text: What did the two blind men sitting by the road ask Jesus to do?
questions.explanation: When Jesus called them and asked what they wanted, they told him that their eyes might be opened.

answers.text: That he would stay with them
That their eyes might be opened
That he would give them bread
That he would lead them to Jerusalem
